summary: Add browser VM consoles to Nex Controller and the host-local page: ticketed Controller sessions paired with outbound host mTLS tunnels, a direct host-local VNC bridge, stdlib WebSocket framing and bundled noVNC. API impact: new contract (openConsole, consoleStream, agentConsole, report consoles member, console-v1 capability, localConsoleStream). Follow-up in the same batch: central VM power controls (Start, Shut down, Reboot, Force stop) as durable vm-power host tasks; API impact: new contract (powerVM, vm-power command, vm-power-v1 capability).

guide.reason: New operator workflow for opening VM consoles from Controller and the host-local page, with blocked and disconnected states; creation page availability note updated. Power controls workflow added with confirmation, ACPI caveats and recovery.

api.reason: Three Controller routes, one host-local route, a report response member and a host capability are new; both OpenAPI contracts and generated references are updated with the contract check.

verification.method: go test -race ./... (wsock framing, VNC socket resolution, Controller ticket authorization/pairing/relay/timeout, agent tunnel, host-local bridge), Python contract/documentation checks, UI typecheck/build, and tests/integration/console_lab.py browser walkthroughs of both consoles against a running guest in a disposable nested-KVM lab; results and limits in the QA report. Power: vmhost/controller Go tests and the same lab run exercising Start, Reboot and Force stop from the browser.
